title: 하늘을 보고 말해요: 비가 올 것 같아요
objective: By the end, you can choose the right form of -는 것 같다 for verbs and adjectives. You can use it to say what seems true now, what seems to have happened, and what will probably happen.
summary: Learn how to make a guess about the present, the past, and the future with -는 것 같다, -(으)ㄴ 것 같다, and -(으)ㄹ 것 같다.

task.title: Make your best guess
task.line: Look at the word and the time hint in brackets, then use -는, -(으)ㄴ, or -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요.

forms.when: Action verbs, and words ending in 있다/없다, when you guess about something happening now.
forms.example: 민수 씨가 지금 전화하는 것 같아요.
forms.exampleMeaning: It seems Minsu is on the phone right now.

forms.when: Adjectives, when you guess about now. After a vowel add -ㄴ. After a consonant add -은.
forms.example: 이 가방은 좀 비싼 것 같아요.
forms.exampleMeaning: This bag seems a bit expensive.

forms.when: Action verbs, when you guess about something that already happened.
forms.example: 수진 씨는 벌써 집에 간 것 같아요.
forms.exampleMeaning: It looks like Sujin has already gone home.

forms.when: Verbs and adjectives, when you guess about the future or something you can't see yet.
forms.means: I think (something) will ... / It will probably ...
forms.example: 하늘이 어두워요. 곧 비가 올 것 같아요.
forms.exampleMeaning: The sky is dark. It looks like it's going to rain soon.

watchOut: 맛있은 것 같아요 (X) → 맛있는 것 같아요 (O): Words ending in 있다/없다 (맛있다, 재미없다) take -는 in the present, like verbs.
바쁘는 것 같아요 (X) → 바쁜 것 같아요 (O): Adjectives don't take -는 (except words ending in 있다/없다). Use -(으)ㄴ for now.
춥을 것 같아요 (X) → 추울 것 같아요 (O): With most ㅂ words, ㅂ changes to 우 before -을/-은 (춥다 → 추울, 추운).
멀은 것 같아요 (X) → 먼 것 같아요 (O): A final ㄹ drops before -는 and -ㄴ (멀다 → 먼, 놀다 → 노는). With -ㄹ, keep just one ㄹ (멀다 → 멀).
exercises: Fill in the blank with 자다 (happening now): 아기가 방에서 ____ 것 같아요.
Choose the correct word: 그 영화는 좀 (재미없은 / 재미없는) 것 같아요.
Rewrite as a guess about the past: 동생이 케이크를 다 먹었어요. → 동생이 케이크를 다 ____ 것 같아요.
Fill in the blank with 길다 (now): 이 바지는 저한테 좀 ____ 것 같아요.
Fill in the blank with 덥다 (guess about tomorrow): 내일은 오늘보다 더 ____ 것 같아요.
Finish each guess in Korean. Use the word and time in brackets: ① 친구가 아침부터 아무것도 안 먹었어요. 지금 (배고프다, now) ____. ② 마이클 씨는 한국어를 아주 잘해요. 한국에서 오래 (살다, past) ____. ③ 하늘이 아주 맑아요. 오늘은 비가 안 (오다, future) ____.
answers: ① 배고픈 것 같아요 ② 산 것 같아요 ③ 올 것 같아요
